name: ExpoMotion
description: Multi-Exposure Fusion (MEF) effectively extends dynamic range, but practical deployment is hindered by motion-induced ghosting and the scarcity of high-quality dynamic benchmarks. Current benchmarks largely neglect dynamic scenes and lack reliable ground truth, making it difficult to handle the complexity of real-world motions. In response, we introduce ExpoMotion, a large-scale benchmark designed to evaluate deghosting capabilities.
